fact: Swoop, an Eswatini-based startup, raised USD 7.3 million in seed funding backed by Long Journey, Variant, Version One, Dune Ventures, Soma Capital, Zero Knowledge Ventures, Walter Kortschak and Base Capital, in April 2026.
title: Rare Eswatini-Born Startup Swoop Raises USD 7.3 M Seed To Enter Nigeria's Food Delivery Market
